The '''Sphere of Technology''', also known as the '''Ministry of Technology''' and the '''Pyramid of Technology''', was one of twelve [[Spheres of Influence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Headed by a [[Dark Council]]or, the Pyramid was responsible for the scientific advancement of the Empire and shared joint control of the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] with the [[Sphere of Biotic Science]]. After [[Darth Mekhis]]' death, [[Darth Hadra]] took her place at the head of the Pyramid and presided over the capital world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After her death at the [[Battle of Corellia]], she was replaced by [[Darth Karrid]], whom was then replaced by [[Darth Acina]] after the former's death at the [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|Battle of Duro]].

After the Empire's defeat at the hand of the [[Eternal Empire]], the Sphere was combined with the [[Sphere of Biotic Science]] into the [[Sphere of Scientific Advancement]] by Empress Acina.<ref name="SOTG" />
